note: Lassen NF campground in pine and fir forest on the south shore of Eagle Lake, rebuilt in the early 2000s as a hookup campground; grey-water dumps in the loops and limited Wi-Fi. The front row (sites 57-75 and 157, 171-173) faces the lake across an open lakebed apron. Showers, laundry, store and boat launch are at Eagle Lake Marina, 2.5 miles away. --Claude
summary: Merrill (Lassen NF, rec.gov 232902): fees 35-60 -> 40-70 (rec.gov: $40 no-hookup, $60 water/electric, $70 full hookup, 2026+2027; FS page still posts $35/$50/$60); booking confirmed reservable + some first-come (sites 15-42, 57-75), 4-day cutoff added; hookups 50 A/water/sewer, 172 sites, max 83 ft, flush/potable/dump/wifi confirmed; season (manual) left; closed for winter (normal season end); front row faces the lake across a ~120-250 m apron - lakeview lead.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (up, not waterfront -> lakeview): on Esri imagery the front row - sites 057-075 (first-come), 157, 171-173 - stands at the forest edge facing an open, unused grass/sand lakebed apron with nothing between them and Eagle Lake; the imagery waterline is ~120 m off and the apron runs ~120-250 m (3DEP: 1559.1 m at site 072 falling ~1 m per 25 m to 1552.4 m at 281 m). Too far for on-water under the ~50 m bound, but the curation doc's floor ('a pad on open ground with the water visible and unscreened across that ground is at LEAST *view') applies. Proposed evidence: 'Esri imagery + rec.gov site points 2026-11-26: front-row sites 057-075, 157, 171-173 at the forest edge face Eagle Lake across an open unused lakebed apron ~120-250 m wide; no screen -> lakeview; too far for lakefront.' The stored evidence ('loops set ~200m+ back ... no sites at/near the water') missed the open sightline.

FEE CONFLICT: the FS page posts '$35 / $50 electric / $60 full hook-ups / $80 double'; recreation.gov's 2026 and 2027 rate tables and per-site prices are $40 / $60 / $70 (group $90). Wrote rec.gov. The two pages also differ on the dump fee (FS $10, rec.gov $5); wrote the FS figure in the fees note.
